name: source-search-physical-lines
objective: Repository code search can fail to build its index, select incorrect Python declarations, or report misleading source/window line locations when valid source contains non-newline separators within strings or comments. Diagnose and correct this end-to-end source representation defect. Python physical lines are LF, CRLF or CR; other Unicode/ASCII separators are source characters, not physical line breaks. Preserve exact original Unicode and newlines, decorated/nested synchronous and asynchronous symbol spans, canonical declaration/occurrence identity, enclosing expansion and deterministic overlapping windows. Non-Python windows must use the same physical-line convention. Invalid Python must retain the documented file fallback. Preserve APIs and existing ranking behavior. Do not alter tests or acceptance.
oracle:
import ast,sys,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from tests.context.retrieval.source.test_search import _index
from devtools.context.retrieval import search_repository_source
separators=('\v','\f','\x1c','\x1d','\x1e','\x85','\u2028','\u2029')
checked=0
for newline in ('\n','\r\n','\r'):
 for sep in separators:
  text=("prefix = 'café"+sep+"雪'"+newline+'@trace'+newline+'class Owner:'+newline+'    @memo'+newline+'    async def fetch(self):'+newline+"        return 'needle 雪'"+newline+newline+'def tail():'+newline+"    return 'end'"+newline)
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
   try:
    index=_index(Path(folder),{'example.py':text,'broken.py':'def broken(:'+newline,'note.txt':'note'+sep+'more'+newline})
   except Exception as error:
    raise AssertionError('Source index must accept valid physical-line Python: '+repr((newline,sep))) from error
   file=next(u for u in index.views[0].units if str(u.resource.address)=='example.py')
   symbols={u.qualified_name:u for u in index.views[1].units if u.kind=='symbol'}
   owner=symbols['Owner']; method=symbols['Owner.fetch']; tail=symbols['tail']
   expected_owner='@trace'+newline+'class Owner:'+newline+'    @memo'+newline+'    async def fetch(self):'+newline+"        return 'needle 雪'"
   expected_method='@memo'+newline+'    async def fetch(self):'+newline+"        return 'needle 雪'"
   assert owner.text==expected_owner,(newline,sep,owner.text)
   assert method.text==expected_method,(newline,sep,method.text)
   assert tail.text=='def tail():'+newline+"    return 'end'"
   assert (owner.start_line,owner.end_line)==(2,6)
   assert (method.start_line,method.end_line)==(4,6)
   assert (tail.start_line,tail.end_line)==(8,9)
   assert (file.start_line,file.end_line)==(1,9)
   assert index.expand(method,to='class')==owner
   assert method.parent_symbol_id==owner.id
   for unit in (owner,method,tail):
    assert unit.text==text[unit.start:unit.end]
    assert unit.snapshot_id==index.snapshot.id
    assert unit.resource is file.resource
   windows=[u for u in index.views[2].units if u.resource==file.resource]
   assert [(u.start_line,u.end_line) for u in windows]==[(1,5),(4,8),(7,9)]
   assert windows[0].text==text[:text.index("        return")]
   assert windows[-1].text.endswith("    return 'end'"+newline)
   assert windows[0].start==0 and windows[-1].end==len(text)
   for left,right in zip(windows,windows[1:]):
    assert left.end>=right.start
   checked+=1
print('QWEN_BEHAVIOR_PASSED',checked,'physical-line/source-search combinations')
